// Package badstorefuncaliasholder is a synthetic KNOWN-BAD fixture for
// schemaversion_stamp_gate_test.go's fileRefsQdrantClient and
// qdrantClientLocalNames (exercised by
// TestFileRefsQdrantClientDetectsFunctionValueAlias and
// TestQdrantClientLocalNamesFollowsFunctionValueAlias). It binds the shared
// constructor store.NewQdrantClient to a package-level var, then calls it
// through that var — the function-value-alias bypass named in
// 01-REVIEW.md WR-01, gap 1. Without following the alias, the resulting
// client-bound identifier ("c" below) would never be registered by
// qdrantClientLocalNames, so a write on it would be completely unguarded by
// TestQdrantClientIsHeldOnlyByStorePackage's write-boundary check.
//
// Deliberately does NOT name the *qdrant.Client type anywhere (no qdrant
// import at all) — the return value is left untyped (`any`) so this
// fixture isolates the bare-value-reference bypass from the pre-existing
// qdrant.Client type-reference check, which would otherwise make
// TestFileRefsQdrantClientDetectsFunctionValueAlias pass for the wrong
// reason.
//
// This file carries a .go.txt extension deliberately: it is parsed from
// source bytes by go/parser, never built by `go build`/gofmt/go vet/the
// linter, so it is not swept by any of them.
package badstorefuncaliasholder

import (
	"github.com/seanb4t/engram/internal/store"
)

// dial aliases the shared constructor as a value.
var dial = store.NewQdrantClient

func newHolder(host string, port int) (any, error) {
	c, err := dial(host, port)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return c, nil
}
